result.summary: Square renewal reviewed natively at 1600×1000. Fixed lights and spatial source meshes remove camera-distance light competition; 115→66 logical fittings, five enterable saved shops, upper park and colliding reusable barriers. All normal source builds/audits, complete scripts/test.sh, 61 real doorway/Continue checks and full-square eight-light budget pass. Three measured views improve; Rootwell remains the draw-call hotspot. See review for source versions, scope and measurements.
